name: Asakura Jun'ichi
source: Jun'ichi was the protagonist of D.C.I. Now he is an old man and doesn't participate in the story of Da Capo II almost at all. He can still create Japanese sweets and still hasn't gotten rid of his habit of saying "What a pain in the neck." Jun'ichi has a pair of granddaughters, [url=/c4053]Otome[/url] and [url=/c4054]Yume[/url]. He is willing to do anything for the sake of their happiness.
